description: Anonymized-query estimate: Search Console omits some rare queries entirely from a query-dimensioned response to protect searcher privacy (Google's own documented behaviour, not this codebase's assumption). This compares the SUM of named per-query clicks/impressions against the property's TRUE undimensioned total for the same window — the gap is a real, derived anonymized-query volume. Charges no credits but spends TWO Search Console requests of Google's per-property quota per call. ALWAYS narrow on `state` first: `not_connected`, `requires_reconnect` (the bound property's Google grant can no longer be used), `no_search_data` (Search Console returned nothing for the window — an absence of data, NOT zero anonymization), `analysed`. On `analysed`, ALWAYS check `possiblyRowCapped`: when true, part of the gap is queries the 1,000-row named-query fetch did not reach, not privacy anonymization — the estimate then overstates true anonymization.

dateRange.description: Convenience window (default 'last_28_days'). This DOES call Google, so Search Console's usual ~16-month clamp and ~3-day data lag both apply.

endDate.description: Explicit end date (YYYY-MM-DD). Use with startDate.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

startDate.description: Explicit start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Use with endDate.

name: get_gsc_anonymous_queries
